## About
Our shop is on Sepulveda Blvd in Van Nuys. Ask for Jason, the owner. Reviewers say he answers the calls, shares what's going on and keeps them posted until the car is back in their hands.
We know an unexpected accident can be very stressful. So we take it from the first call: free towing to our shop right after an accident, a courtesy ride back to your home or office, help with your insurance claim and a rental car if you have no other way to get around.
Our paint technicians use computerized paint mixing and work in a pristine paint booth, and we follow original manufacturer's specifications on body, frame and mechanical repairs. We work on all makes and models, from lease returns to classic cars. Google rating: 4.4 from 43 reviews.

## Services
- Auto Paint Services: Paint work after your body repair, done by our paint technicians in a pristine paint booth.
- Dent Repair & Frame Work: From small dings to frame repair. Bumpers, doors, roofs, fenders, quarter panels and hoods.
- Claim Assistance: We help you with your claim after the accident, from the very beginning to the very end.
- Custom Matte Paint: Want your car to turn heads around town? We can work with you on designing a custom color.
- Classic Car Restoration: Got a classic sitting and waiting? We'll help you restore it to its original condition and get it back on the road.
- Windshield Repair: Cracked windshield? Our technicians will fix, repair or replace it.
- Wheel and Rim Repair: LA streets are rough on wheels. Stop by and let our technician take a look at your bent wheels.

## FAQ
Q: Will you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We'll answer your questions and help you through the whole process, including coordinating your insurance claim and arranging a rental car.

Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: We work on all makes and models.

Q: How do I schedule an estimate?
A: Give us a call, or fill out the contact form on our site with your name, contact information and a time that works for you.

Q: Can I pick up a rental car at your shop?
A: Yes, pickup from our shop is available.
